announcements.title: GigInsight Beta Update — v0.4.46
announcements.body:
A major update to GigInsight is rolling out on Google Play! This release focuses on improving the accuracy, reliability, transparency, and overall usability of your gig tracking experience.

NEW: UNDERSTAND YOUR NUMBERS

You can now tap individual metrics within Insights to see:
• What each metric means.
• How it is calculated.
• The actual values used in your calculation.
• Why the metric matters to your business.

This allows you to better understand and verify your earnings, expenses, profitability, mileage, time, and estimated tax information.

IMPROVED TIME TRACKING

Time tracking terminology and calculations have been standardized throughout the app, including notifications and floating controls.

• Active Time — time spent actively working.
• Searching Time — time spent looking for work, including repositioning.
• Personal Time — time spent on personal activities while online.
• Dedicated Business Time — Active + Searching.
• Total Online Time — Active + Searching + Personal.

The Order Timer remains optional. Your tracked work time counts even when you choose not to use it.

ENHANCED HYPER ANALYTICS

Gain a more comprehensive understanding of your performance with six hourly earnings metrics:

• Gross earnings per Active Hour
• Profit per Active Hour
• Gross earnings per Dedicated Business Hour
• Profit per Dedicated Business Hour
• Gross earnings per Online Hour
• Profit per Online Hour

Weekday comparisons and historical performance charts have also been improved, including more accurate weighted averages, clearer data coverage, improved chart interactions, and better handling of incomplete historical records.

Missing information is now more clearly distinguished from actual zero values.

GREATER CONTROL OVER GIG PROFILES

You can now choose which gig profiles contribute to your combined analytics.

This is especially useful for keeping test profiles, miscellaneous income, or other work separate from your overall gig performance without deleting their individual histories.

Find this option under Settings → Profiles.

IMPROVED SCREENSHOT EARNINGS IMPORT

Screenshot recognition is now more reliable when identifying previously taught earnings categories, particularly when minor text recognition errors occur.

Additional safeguards help prevent ambiguous values from being assigned to the wrong earnings category.

IMPROVED BACKUP AND RESTORE

• Profile backups now include vehicle definitions to better preserve vehicle names and operating costs.
• Added clearer confirmation before replacing existing profile data.
• Improved protection of existing records during restoration.
• Strengthened internal storage and automatic recovery safeguards.
• Added protection against accidentally deleting tracked time from overnight shifts.

UPDATED USER GUIDE

The built-in User Guide has been revised to better explain time tracking, profitability calculations, mileage tracking, the optional Order Timer, and backup functionality.

IN-APP ANNOUNCEMENTS

You're reading our first official in-app software update announcement! This feature will allow us to communicate future updates, important notices, and improvements directly within GigInsight.

Thank you for participating in the GigInsight beta. Your feedback helps improve the app as development continues toward our official Android and iOS releases.

Please continue reporting any bugs, inconsistencies, or suggestions through the in-app feedback feature.
